description: Write several things in ONE atomic call. Every item is validated first; if any item is invalid NOTHING is written and the response names which one; if all are valid they are written in a single transaction and you get exactly one acknowledgement per item, in input order. Nothing is ever partially applied or silently dropped. A retry with the same idempotency_key returns the first response and writes nothing.

items.description: Each item is { op, ... } where op is post_card, message, answer, match or open.

name: pipeline_batch
title: Write several things at once
